title: Acceptance targets measurement regime
stmt: Wall-clock and GPU targets run nightly at 60 and 120 Hz on D-T classes; PRs gate on C17 counters. With D-T open, counters and software goldens close WS5, WS6, WS8, WS12 and M4-M5. M6 needs one recorded wall-clock run of every flagship target, so M6 waits on D-T.
choice: Hardware nightly; counters per PR; M6 closes on a hardware wall-clock run
rationale: Counters are exact on shared VMs; incumbent speed parity needs real machines.

title: AI backend placement
stmt: Where each nn backend runs.
choice: WGSL on the app device; CPU tract in the worker over read-only model segments; others in craft-nn-helper.
rationale: Model parsers stay out of the app; tract in the worker keeps seeded determinism.

title: BUILD_DEFAULTS
name: BUILD_DEFAULTS
stmt: One switch per decided capability.
choice: All on except web CefWindow and windows_wfp WhenInstalled.
rationale: Owner veto is a one-line change.

title: Brush engine row
stmt: Brush engine contribution row.
choice: Dab or stroke kernel (GT1, GT2, GT3 or Wasm) emitting dabs, tiles or gpu, with GPU state persist=stroke or layer in the paint slot.

title: Build order is sequencing only
stmt: Platform build order is sequencing only: streams A-H run in parallel with one build owner; the three app streams run in parallel once ext-runtime exists.

title: CI capacity plan
stmt: PR workflow per repo, concurrency per ref, cancel-in-progress. macOS cap 5 per account: PR macOS jobs go by repository_dispatch to the craft-extensions orchestrator queue (<=2 running); nightly it runs every repo's shards (8 Ubuntu, 6 Windows, 3 macOS at once) within 4 h; chaos, fuzz and threat-map shards use fixed seeds, one same-seed retry.

title: craft-ai and craft-ai-core are never plugin-reachable
stmt: craft-ai and craft-ai-core are cloud AI providers needing the network, so plugins never reach them; craft-nn is the plugin-facing inference path.
choice: Plugins reach inference only through craft-nn
rationale: Cloud AI providers need the network, which plugins do not have.

title: Codeshift built at M5
stmt: Codeshift builds at M5, when T6 on CEF and figma-compat land.

title: Commit conventions
stmt: Owner noreply author, truthful Co-Authored-By, explicit paths, [skip ci] unless a run is approved.

title: cost-feedback-ema
stmt: Gate routes heavy calls off the owner; no author decides it
choice: Static Meta.cost drafts plus measured EMA per command and size bucket
rationale: Authors cannot be trusted to estimate scale-dependent cost.

title: Apps take craft-libs through a patch table of path dependencies
stmt: In plugin-beta branches apps take craft-libs crates through [patch."https://github.com/storytold/craft-libs"] pointing at ../craft-libs/crates/<name>, so path dependencies work and upstream stays untouched.
rationale: Path dependencies work and the upstream stays untouched.

title: CUT gates are required hosted checks
stmt: CUT1-CUT5 run kept-behaviour and corpus parity plus a C17 counter step (new path no worse than the old runtime per call in instructions, IPC and copies on the CUT corpus) as required hosted checks: Ubuntu and Windows jobs, a step of the macOS PR sandbox job. A red gate blocks the deletion.
choice: Required hosted checks within the PR budget
rationale: Mechanical hard cut gated by parity.

title: Cut UI set delivered before each cut
stmt: By M2 for FigCraft: T1 node kinds and forms on ext-ui-paint with C22.
choice: Cut UI set precedes the rest of each WS6 task
rationale: Cut gates CUT1-CUT3 include UI rows.

title: Plugin may hand links to the user's browser
stmt: Plugins may hand https, http or mailto links, or a browser file they wrote, to the user's browser or mail app: ui.open_url, L0, switch ui_open_url.
rationale: Help, licence and clicked links need it; the browser does the transfer.
name: D-A

title: D-B automatic selection writes, script prefs
stmt: selection.write runs in Automatic contexts for plugins holding app.automation (never Hook or Render); app.preferences:{scripts,automation} grantable at L2; transfer-enabling keys stay Protected.
rationale: Context table and Protected refusal enforce it; the sheet discloses it.

title: Script network prefs
stmt: Script network prefs stay Protected.

title: D-C clipboard
stmt: Clipboard is gesture-only; clipboard.monitor relaxes it.

title: D-D docking web panels
stmt: Built state CefWindow: T6 panels float as slot-following palettes; migrate --to-t1 ports them to docking T1. All modes built and tested (O6, WEB1-4, S-WEB1, BD1); only docking parity waits.
choice: Recommended: CefDocked; narrower CefDockedCompat docks only imported UXP and CEP
rationale: Incumbent panels dock; one frame of latency at 60 fps (S-WEB1).
name: D-D

title: D-E full access
stmt: Full-access helpers and programs exist.
choice: Accept; notice.full_access; O4b keeps the threat map.
name: D-E

title: D-F unconfined Windows
stmt: Unconfined launches only with WFP active.
name: D-F

stmt: native.full from any tier for any helper (craft-aehost, OFX bridge, video output, plugin helpers such as kiln-live) behind two-step consent and notice.full_access; Community builds add notice.standard, signer pin and provenance.
choice: native.full from any tier behind two-step consent

title: Run-time generated WGSL under gpu.compile
stmt: Generated WGSL under gpu.compile (GT1) is promoted when worst-case cost fits GpuSubmit; package strikes apply.

stmt: Expression libraries are document data under document.scripts; tainted expressions evaluate only in ext-expr.
choice: Closed by R2: no in-process exception.

title: FigCraft protocol 4
stmt: Protocol 4 with schema 3.

stmt: craft-pshost, craft-aehost (AEGP, Panelator, AEIO) and the OFX bridge are clean-room and ship in beta; Adobe SDK header licensing review gates public releases.
choice: Recommended: beta now, public after review

stmt: collab.presence, gesture-only L1.

stmt: Render contexts read bound File and Folder parameters, held read grants and package blobs as snapshots with recorded hashes.

title: D-O live writes
stmt: Plugin writes to live documents need collab.write.
choice: Switch collab_write on; L2 with notice.live_session.

stmt: Native helpers with a granted clipboard.* permission use the OS clipboard at their level (L3, L4), disclosed by notice.native_ui; otherwise the broker on a gesture. BD1 and O4b run both states.

title: Pending-vocabulary mechanism
stmt: Pending-vocabulary mechanism

title: D-S companions
stmt: Companion apps over signer-pinned local IPC.
choice: devices.companion with notice.companion; no loopback IP.

title: D-T CI hardware runners
stmt: Three self-hosted runners (REQ-COM-machine-class-rule), one job each: nightly hardware correctness suites, then performance at 20% thresholds; hw PRs run the subset. Hosted runners with device mocks close M4 and M5; the M6 beta exit waits on D-T.
rationale: Hosted runners lack real GPUs, audio and displays.
name: D-T
options: Hosted runners only (M6 beta exit blocked)

stmt: WFP filter and helper service, one elevated prompt.
choice: windows_wfp WhenInstalled; policy may require. Without it unconfined launches are refused; LPAC profiles hold no network capability.
rationale: Backstop for full mode only; no switch sets plugin network.
name: D-U

title: egui fork with on_wake and recreate_device
stmt: arnav-hiwarkar/egui plus a Forgejo copy from the pinned revisions add only App::on_wake and Painter::recreate_device, used via [patch]; nothing touches storytold.

title: Selection writes
stmt: selection.write is its own permission.

title: Preference groups
stmt: plugins, security, grants never; scripts and automation L2.
choice: D-B grants scripts and automation groups.

title: Reads and pure commands run on snapshots; commit is one owner hop
stmt: Reads and pure commands run on runtime threads against O(1) snapshots; commit is one owner hop with rebase (replaces every call being a UI-thread hop).
choice: Snapshot reads, single owner-hop commit with rebase
rationale: UI thread must not wait on plugins.

title: DocumentHost size and Runner
stmt: DocumentHost size and Runner
choice: DocumentHost carries size, Runner and the heavy_commands_run_off_owner check.
rationale: Cross-document alignment recorded in the PhotoCraft cross-doc change table.

title: egui fork
stmt: Sibling fork at plugin-beta/egui, branch plugin-beta.
choice: Fork egui with App::on_wake, Painter::recreate_device and Painter::configure_surface (extended-range format, EDR flag, headroom query) only
rationale: eframe runs app code only inside a paint and cannot set the extended-range surface HDR viewers need.

title: Out-of-scope returns -3 NotFound
stmt: Out-of-scope returns -3 NotFound, identical to absent ids. -2 Denied means a missing permission. App-specific failures use detail, never new numbers.
choice: -3 for a target outside the scope token, identical to an absent id; no new numbers

title: Execution path chosen by Meta and doc size
stmt: Execution path is chosen by Meta and the document's size, never by the plugin author.
choice: pure calls run on the runtime thread pool via exec_detached with read-your-writes; heavy calls (meta.cost.heavy(size)) are Runner::Doc commands on the job pool appending to the TxnLog, report progress after 250 ms and stay cancellable.
rationale: Keeps the owner thread free and the author unable to opt into a slower or less safe path.
detail: Also: other non-pure calls take the live-writer lease, flush the detached log into the live document in the event's TxnMark and hop to the owner.

title: ext-host deleted; no in-process plugin execution
stmt: Renames ext-ui to ext-ui-paint, guest to craft-guest, native-sdk to craft-native and deletion of ext-host land in one change per rename that updates every path-dependent sibling (craft-launcher root Cargo.toml lines 46-49, craft-plugins/examples, the three beta apps crates/plugins). ext-host is deleted when ext-runtime, ext-engine and ext-broker land. wasmi stays in ext-engine as CI reference engine and iOS engine.
choice: One change per rename updating all path-dependent siblings; delete ext-host
rationale: Nothing keeps an in-process plugin execution path on desktop or web; iOS runs interpreted engines in-process only under ext-engine::inproc containment.

title: Fixed names: gate::admit, --safe-mode, craft-plugin-web
stmt: Gate entry is gate::admit (no authorize); safe mode is --safe-mode, Shift at launch, or CRAFT_SAFE_MODE=1 (PHOTOCRAFT_SAFE_MODE and FIGCRAFT_SAFE_MODE removed); web helper binary is craft-plugin-web.

stmt: M4: Prism, Glide, Steady, Flowline. M5: Ember, Halo, Rigwise, Lumina, Oilworks, Argent, Tonemask, Cutout, Pulse, Tokenbook, Lens, Tracer, Codeshift, Seam, Hush, Strata, Grainbox, Facet, Tasklet. M6: the rest and the hosted builds.

stmt: fonts.activate L1 and fonts.system L2.

stmt: M0: C0 ratchet (no new command without Meta), C11, C13, C18, C19, C20, C23. M1: C0 full, C1-C7, C10. M2: C8, C9, C12, C14, C17 counters, C21, C22, C16 worker rows. M3: C16 all profiles. M4: C15, C24. Hardware C17 with D-T.

stmt: GT1-GT4 built with one validator and R40.

title: Hard cut per subsystem gated by parity
stmt: Each old subsystem in the cut register is deleted in the same change that lands its replacement, and that change merges only when its cut gate is green in Actions on macOS, Ubuntu 24.04 and Windows (kept-behaviour parity plus corpus parity where one exists). Until its cut an old subsystem keeps running unchanged, old and new never serve the same contribution kind at once, and no milestone leaves a beta app without a
choice: Delete-with-replacement only when the cut gate is green on three OSes
rationale: v1 decision 18; the old systems run unconfined on Windows today so no cut precedes the Windows profiles it needs (M2 worker, M3 rest). M2 and M3 are two and four weeks later than a cut without parity.

title: Heavy routing is gate step 11
stmt: Heavy routing is gate step 11 of OP-COM-gate-admit (Cost::heavy, exec_detached, install, off-owner rebase, Long commands inside an open txn), not an exposure row. A plugin holding print picks any OS-configured print queue by id, network-backed ones included, and prints with or without the dialog; only endpoint URIs the plugin supplies return -9. The fonts.install op writes the OS user font folder under fonts.system.
choice: Gate step 11 routes heavy and in-transaction Long commands; print grants queue choice and silent print on every OS-configured queue; the fonts.install op targets the OS user font folder, no elevation.
rationale: Incumbent scripts print silently and pick printers, network printers included (ExtendScript printOneCopy, print settings); the OS spooler, not the plugin, reaches the printer, so DEC-COM-no-plugin-network covers only plugin-supplied endpoints.

title: Helper per plugin
stmt: Decode and nn helpers run per plugin.

title: History control savepoints
stmt: History control savepoints
choice: History control has savepoints inside script runs, txn.modal and Action replays; selecting one restores the working snapshot inside the transaction; an older state splits the run (4.3).
rationale: Cross-document alignment recorded in the PhotoCraft cross-doc change table.

title: Generic command interception hooks
stmt: Intercept is declared on commands outside the latency-critical set; user-chosen Override and Observe cover every command including view, selection, nudge and tool commands, Override under its CON-COM-hook-kinds budget. All are ordered, bypassable, fail-open, never block the UI thread and run under the plugin origin; kinds, points and event families are generated from the apps.
rationale: Replaces v1 no generic command interception.

title: input.monitor at L4
stmt: Global input is grantable.

title: app.intercept color.picker
stmt: app.intercept gains color.picker (PhotoCraft Color Picker replacement, 4.15)

title: interceptable-default-false
stmt: interceptable (queued Intercept) defaults to false and cmd! refuses it on view, selection, nudge and tool commands; overridable and Observe are allowed there, Override under its hook budget (CON-COM-hook-kinds: decision p99 4 ms, built-in at 8 ms). Lifecycle save/close, AppLifecycle, PluginMgmt, protected PrefsWrite, trust, manager and Stop-all commands refuse both flags.
choice: Ban only queued Intercept on latency-critical commands; allow Override and Observe on them; ban both on the trust and lifecycle set
rationale: A queued Intercept would add up to its budget to every arrow key, zoom step and click-select; Override has a 4 ms p99 decision budget with the built-in at 8 ms, so launcher and automation plugins can replace tool and selection behaviour within one frame.

title: Clean-room jsxbin decoder
stmt: jsxbin decoding is written from the documented format and decodes straight to AST.
choice: Decode to ESTree AST, never to re-parsed source

choice: Manifest lists [contribution.photocraft] filter keys (modes, depths, space, needs, output, preview, smart, handles_selection, gallery), [contribution.brush-engine] (inputs, reads, emits, program, dag, reach, entry, params, presets) with [[contribution.brush-engine.state]] (id, kind, format, size, pe
rationale: Cross-document alignment recorded in the PhotoCraft cross-doc change table.

title: Merge a6b9d9c into craft-libs plugin-beta
stmt: PhotoCraft's craft-libs pin a6b9d9c is merged into plugin-beta by merge commit; no rebase, nothing from storytold; all other pins are ancestors of both sides.
rationale: Rebasing drops framework features PhotoCraft uses.

title: Meta Cost and DocSize with Cost::heavy
stmt: Meta Cost and DocSize with Cost::heavy
choice: Meta carries Cost and DocSize; Cost::heavy is judged against BUDGETS[OwnerFrame] through Runner; there is no OWNER_BUDGET_NS. PrefKey::Endpoint keys naming servers (CUPS_SERVER, print server) are never plugin-writable.
rationale: Cross-document alignment recorded in the PhotoCraft cross-doc change table.

title: NativeHostKind UxpAddon
stmt: NativeHostKind UxpAddon
rationale: Cross-document alignment recorded in the PhotoCraft cross-doc change table.

title: No ACG on JIT
stmt: Worker and CEF lack ACG.

title: No code comments, every rule has a deterministic test
stmt: No code comments; every rule has a deterministic test; lessons go to AGENTS.md.

title: No JIT in app
stmt: JIT engines run only in the worker.

title: No plugin can block save, export, quit or close
stmt: No plugin can block save, export, quit or close (N7); the user may cancel from the findings sheet.
choice: Before-hooks are bounded and fail open, modal transactions roll back on quit, persistence reads only committed revisions, and no hook can block save, export, quit or close.
rationale: User data safety and exit must not depend on third-party code.

title: no-plugin-codecs
stmt: Plugins never ship a codec for a user-picked file or package asset
choice: image.decode, media.decode and pdf.page.render run over craft-media in the confined helper
rationale: Parsers stay confined and hardware decode stays on the GPU.

title: No plugin network
stmt: net.fetch, network:<host>, net.local, secrets, OAuth, remote web content and model downloads are removed (owner decision); plugins are offline. Host-owned channels stay: store, catalogue, live document sync (collab.write). The only loopback path is the licensing ip-relay (CON-SEC-licensing-daemons@1). Plugin-written endpoints and remote references are excluded (6.2 rule 2).
choice: Network, secrets, OAuth and loopback leave the vocabulary; permission Network(String) and is_network() are deleted; Effect::Net stays for app-origin commands and every app sink::net refuses a Via chain holding a plugin; network:* manifests fail to parse; N6 refuses network of any kind.
rationale: Owner decision; offline replacements cover incumbents.

title: no-wit-component-model
stmt: WIT and the component model are not used for the ABI
choice: Guest imports exactly seven functions; JS and Wasm cross the same descriptors
rationale: Keeps one descriptor path for JavaScript and Wasm.

title: Nothing is built before M-1
stmt: Only WS0 commits before the briefing. Order: briefing; common platform; EffectCraft, PhotoCraft and FigCraft as the owner's one step, FigCraft's adapter first at M2 as the smallest proof of Runtime<A>; flagships prove them by M6; then the other Craft apps.

title: CEF only
stmt: CEF is the only web engine.

title: One wgpu host
stmt: All apps use wgpu 30.0.1.

title: D-A open URL
stmt: ui.open_url accepts http, https, mailto.
choice: Gesture plus full-address sheet; browser does the network.

title: Ordered cold start
stmt: Workers start by visibility after the first frame.

title: origin-by-value
stmt: Authorization is a value parameter, never ambient
choice: Thread-locals, task-locals, statics and Session fields holding Origin are banned; every queued item captures Authorization by value
rationale: Ambient origins leak across threads and queued work.

title: Owner decision id registry
stmt: decisions-v2.md is the registry (common 19.2 mirrors it; security maps switches; apps cite D-ids, C20). Open: D-D, D-K, D-T. All others are decided, switched in BUILD_DEFAULTS and tested both ways (BD1).
choice: One registry, open set D-D, D-K, D-T

title: owner-frame-heavy-budget
stmt: Heavy routing uses BUDGETS[OwnerFrame]; PhotoCraft's separate 8 ms constant is removed
choice: heavy = max(estimate_ns, ema) > OwnerFrame interactive budget
rationale: A command that ran over once is routed off the owner even when its static estimate is wrong.

title: PagedTexture
stmt: Layer-sized GPU state is paged 256x256.

title: Synthesised panel show and hide
stmt: Host synthesises invokable panel.show:<id> and panel.hide:<id> commands per panel contribution.

title: Per-PR gates use deterministic counters only
stmt: C17 per PR gates instruction and logical counters, never time; every app uses these thresholds.
choice: >2% instructions or any logical counter increase fails; CPU ns reported
rationale: Counts are exact on shared VMs.

title: Vocabulary v2
stmt: Security vocabulary with one level per name.

title: photoshop.jsx and photoshop-uxp contracts
stmt: photoshop.jsx and photoshop-uxp contracts
choice: Register photoshop.jsx@1 and photoshop-uxp@1 beside figma-compat; EffectCraft's ScriptUI to UI 1.3 converter moves to shared craft-extensions/crates/ext-js/scriptui so extendscript@1 and photoshop.jsx@1 both use it.
rationale: Cross-document alignment recorded in the PhotoCraft cross-doc change table.

title: pkg-assets-not-copied
stmt: Package assets are passed to commands by read-only pkg.open handles, never copied
choice: pkg.open is free and needs no files.* grant; the fs broker serves from the verified package directory
rationale: Templates, footage, brushes, LUTs and fonts must import in one step with no grants.

title: Probation device and queue
stmt: Unpromoted and Unbounded digests run on the probation device of CON-EC-gpu-probation@1, ordered by CPU-side fences.
choice: Probation device for all unpromoted work; on web a second GPUDevice hands tiles over per GpuSubmit.
rationale: A looping tile on the app queue would block the next UI present; a separate queue lets the OS preempt, and the 1 s watchdog strikes before an adapter-wide TDR.

title: Draft contradictions resolved in architecture-v2 s21
name: R1-R42
stmt: Every contradiction between the v2 drafts is resolved in architecture-v2 section 21 and applied to the five specs before owner review.
choice: R36: os.handoff reaches only ArtCraft apps. R40: document render separate from UI present; probation splits the walk. R41: test ids NT1, L4C1, HREF1, NNR1, gate C-LPAC. R42: ABI 1 deleted in WS4 task 6.
detail: R36: other programs go through os.open and its sheet. R40: promoted plugin passes run inline mid-stack and a whole frame is late, never one pass. R42: GPU loop maxima from the form schema.

title: Renames guest and native-sdk
stmt: guest becomes craft-guest and native-sdk becomes craft-native with every dependant by M2; at M3 exit in the CUT4 change native-sdk protocol 1 is removed, craft-plugins examples and three beta apps' example plugins rebuilt on ABI 2, and ABI 1 deleted (R42).
choice: Rename by M2; delete ABI 1 at CUT4
rationale: FigCraft cut builds on craft-guest 2.0; ABI 1 deletion needs both adapters.

title: Render and present separate
stmt: UI present, with promoted GT4 within UiPresentPlugin, is its own submit; promoted digests run inline in the document render.
rationale: Submitted GPU work cannot be cancelled.

title: render-session-partition-helpers
stmt: Native helper calls from render contexts go to a separate render-class instance
choice: Process key {package version, id, class: Render} with read-only data folder, no brokered writes and no shared memory with the session instance
rationale: Values computed from pixels read in render can only leave as the render's output.

title: Repos and branches for plugin-beta work
stmt: Repos sit together in plugin-beta; work lands on plugin-beta branches (craft-plugins on main); pushes only to Forgejo and arnav-hiwarkar/*, explicit --repo; never storytold.

title: Profile cut order
stmt: Profiles land in cut order.
choice: restricted M2, rest M3, native UI M5.

title: Review gate for the five documents
stmt: Documents are reviewed only after C20, K1, Q1b and C6 pass.

title: Script provenance
stmt: Every script entry checks provenance.

title: Two Wasmtime engines
stmt: Separate pooled session and on-demand media engines.

title: txn.modal for every app; user events promote to modal
stmt: Long work uses txn.modal for every app; user events promote to modal instead of dying (replaces 5 s and the event is killed).

title: Every app UI toolkit is egui

choice: egui fork shared by every app; no second painter

title: T1-T6 built with one layout engine
stmt: T1-T6 built now, with a style layer and media nodes in T1, helper-owned native windows (T5b)
rationale: DEC-COM-d-d sets the default web mode.

rationale: Apps still migrating stay usable by agents, and unreviewed commands never reach plugins.

title: Beta apps reach zero UNDECLARED before adapters ship

choice: Canonical ops plus the registry bridge behind one gate; 87 canonical ops (R8).

rationale: CreateBrowser takes no opener, so only a renderer popup shares one JS context; the one-shot token keeps page script from opening windows (O6).

title: Workers by memory
stmt: Live workers limited by RSS; idle ones suspend LRU.

title: WS12 spike slice before tasks 4-5
stmt: WS12 task 2 on macOS and Windows x64 and task 3's sample effect on Metal and D3D12 run first, timed; a measured estimate replaces WS12's before tasks 4-5.

title: effectcraft.md cross-doc changes
stmt: effectcraft.md cites common definitions instead of restating them.
choice: Documents reference common definitions instead of restating them
rationale: Single source of truth per fact.

title: photocraft.md cross-doc changes v2
stmt: Path parameters take handles or paths with files.paths; Replay and Batch are a gesture only for the first step or in foreground; -3 outside scope, -12 locked, -5 cancelled; print endpoint not plugin-settable.

title: photocraft.md cross-doc changes v2.2
stmt: BUDGETS[OwnerFrame] replaces OWNER_BUDGET_NS; rebase exhaustion is -4; Authorization passes by value; chunking uses tiles::plan; plugin GPU errors stay attributed.

title: Zygote pool
stmt: Warm confined workers await packages.

title: AE host written from public structure layouts
stmt: The AE host is written from public layouts without SDK headers; users bring licensed binaries.
rationale: Legal exposure is limited to public layouts; user-supplied licences cover binaries.

title: Windows aehost built with macOS
stmt: Windows aehost ships with macOS.
rationale: Parity of platform coverage for the user's installed After Effects plugins.

title: Sim checkpoints charged to plugin accounts
stmt: Sim checkpoints are charged to plugin accounts, never app caches.
rationale: A plugin's simulation must not evict app caches.

title: Plugin ease sampled 257 times
stmt: A plugin ease function is sampled 257 times on apply, following AniCraft's model.
rationale: Table makes the ease durable with no badge.

title: EffectCraft CEP via node-compat
stmt: EffectCraft CEP import uses @craft/node-compat and PhotoCraft's permission scan table; the 5-panel CEP corpus joins EffectCraft tests.

title: EffectCraft font install
stmt: Font installation is allowed through fonts.activate and fonts.system.
rationale: Cross-document alignment recorded in the PhotoCraft cross-doc change table.

title: memcap to MemAccount
stmt: memcap counting moves to MemAccount.

title: EffectCraft Meta.cost routing
stmt: EffectCraft Meta.cost routing
choice: Apply Meta.cost (PerLayer and PerPixel per frame for render-bound commands) with the same automatic job routing.
rationale: Cross-document alignment recorded in the PhotoCraft cross-doc change table.

title: EffectCraft ScriptUI and PsBackend
stmt: EffectCraft uses the shared ScriptUI converter; File.execute maps to os.open or process.run:launch-<ext>; callSystem with shell syntax runs the held shell declaration (confinement full), else -2.

title: EffectCraft taint rule points to PC
stmt: PhotoCraft scripts and .atn files follow EffectCraft's provenance taint rule (pc_jsx_taint, pc_atn_taint); CEP panels use @craft/node-compat/page on the __sync transport.
choice: One provenance rule for scripts, Actions and preset files

title: Expression memo is app cache
stmt: The expression memo is EffectCraft's expression cache (LRU), not a plugin account.
rationale: It stores results of evaluators the app hosts, not plugin-owned data.

title: Provenance decides the expression evaluator
stmt: A property is plugin-tainted when its ExprOrigin is Plugin(id) or its source calls lib() or fn(); a batch whose dependency closure holds a tainted property runs only in ext-expr.
choice: Untainted batches: ext-expr first, expr-boa fallback; expr-boa registers no lib() or fn().
rationale: C11 forbids a JIT in the app process, and plugin code must never run there.

title: fx.apply free
stmt: Cross-package fx.apply needs nothing.

title: GT3 validates a recorded command list, not a live API
stmt: The GT3 proxy validates a list of commands and never executes a live WebGPU object API.
choice: GT3 is the GT2 validator applied to a DAG recorded at runtime.
rationale: Adds no new attack-surface class beyond GT2.

title: Hard cut for legacy plugin systems
stmt: Legacy plugin systems are cut hard

title: JavaScript runs on worker JIT engine
stmt: extendscript@1, js.plugin@1, CEP panels and user and agent scripts run on ext-engine::js (V8 on desktop, QuickJS only on web); JavaScriptCore is not used; only expr-boa remains in the app process for user-authored expressions (gate C24, R2).
choice: V8 worker JIT; no script in the app process
rationale: Resolution R1 and R2 of v2.3 gap pass.

title: Native effects restricted
stmt: Native effects run restricted.

title: App queues never wait on helper-signalled values
stmt: No app GPU queue encodes a wait on a fence value signalled by a helper process.
rationale: UI presentation and every other app submission must never depend on a helper that can stall or die.

title: One gate over canonical ops plus app.run
stmt: One gate over canonical ops plus app.run

title: Corpus hashes before script changes
stmt: Corpus hashes are recorded on today's boa backend at M1; crates/script is deleted only when EC-T17 passes on V8 and QuickJS against them, with C24.
rationale: Parity must be proven against the existing backend's outputs.

title: Script folders replaced by extendscript@1 packages
stmt: The Scripts menu folder, ScriptUI Panels folder and Startup and Shutdown scripts are replaced.
choice: Import script... wraps a .jsx/.js or folder into a Local-tier extendscript@1 package through the CEP import scan and sheet; Startup and Shutdown become app.started and project.opened events.
rationale: One script runtime and one gate for all origins.

title: Socket to net sink
stmt: Socket is an adapter over the net sink.

title: Panelator docks as T5b by default
stmt: Panelator panels dock as a real borderless T5b window over the dock slot by default.
choice: T5b default; T5a only for digests in ext-aehost/fidelity.toml or user-chosen after.
rationale: Real windows give native popups, cursors, drag and drop and IME with the toolkit's own.

title: Scripts in worker
stmt: No script runs in the app process.

title: Sandboxed worker per package version
stmt: A sandboxed worker per package version

title: Switchable decisions behind BUILD_DEFAULTS
stmt: Each switchable decision is built behind its BUILD_DEFAULTS field, set to its decided value.
choice: One BUILD_DEFAULTS field per switchable decision, set to the decided value.
rationale: Keeps the decided behaviour default while the switch stays a single field.

title: Cost drafts from census, k fitted per family
stmt: Cost drafts come from the census; cargo xtask cost-calibrate --app figcraft fits k per family on fixtures/1k.figcraft and fixtures/100k.figcraft and writes crates/engine/src/cmd/meta_cost.rs. Only PerNode, PerPixel and Const exist; no author or adapter decides heavy.
choice: Fit k per family from two fixtures; heavy routing is decided by the runtime from Meta.cost alone.
rationale: Authors and adapters make no routing decision; test heavy_commands_run_off_owner enforces it.

title: Decided D-B: automatic selection.write
stmt: D-B: automatic selection.write is decided.
rationale: Owner decision recorded in final/decisions-v2.md and mirrored in common 19.2.

title: Decided D-G: native full for Community authors
stmt: D-G: native full for Community authors is decided.
choice: D-G: native full for Community authors.
rationale: Owner decision recorded in final/decisions-v2.md and mirrored in common 19.2.

title: Delete the 7 s blocking Bridge::ask
stmt: The 7 s blocking recv_timeout from worker threads waiting on the UI pump (runtime.rs Bridge::ask) is deleted; FigCraft implements the common DocumentHost and runs no queue of its own.
choice: Implement DocumentHost; no private owner queue.
rationale: Waiting on the UI pump blocks workers for seconds.

title: FigCraft Meta.cost PerNode
stmt: Tree-wide commands (booleans, flatten, rename-all, reflow) use Meta.cost PerNode with common routing.

title: Generated permission page
stmt: The permission page is generated from api.lock.json and risk(): help.* links are OpenUrl (ui.open_url, E7), built-in windows and proto.present UiWindow (app.windows), fonts.read L0; document.lifecycle:{save,versions,recent}, history.read and history.control:navigate replace the old names.

title: One theme token source
stmt: theme_vars and --uxp-host-* come from ext_ui_fw::theme; Figma UIs stay async-only.

title: FigCraft integrates first
stmt: FigCraft is the first adapter at M2; WS2 and WS11 delete its old runtime once CUT1 is green.
rationale: Smallest adapter with a CPU canvas.

title: 100% Meta coverage with real schemas and Cost
stmt: Every FigCraft command carries Meta with a real schema and Cost.
choice: FigCraft commits to 100% Meta with real schemas and Cost, not the 60% floor of roadmap P1a.
rationale: Permissions, scope, schemas and execution routing are all derived from Meta, so any gap would be an ungated or unroutable command.

title: Lazy job device
stmt: The desktop export device is made lazily off the UI thread.

title: Hard cut of figcraft.session@1.2
stmt: The legacy session runtime and its hooks are deleted, not kept beside the new system.
choice: Delete figcraft.session@1.2 runtime and engine/shell hooks in the same change as the adapter (decision 18, hard cut).
rationale: One plugin system; no parallel legacy path to secure or maintain.

title: Hard cut of figcraft.session@1.x
stmt: figcraft.session@1.x plugins stop loading and the manager shows "Needs update for FigCraft 2". Their document data (plugin:<id> keys) is kept and becomes readable to the same plugin id under private. Old grants do not carry over; users approve again.
choice: Hard cut with data preserved and re-approval of grants.
rationale: The grant model and contract are replaced wholesale; old grants cannot be mapped safely.

title: BLAKE3 image keys
stmt: New image keys are BLAKE3; sha256 keys stay valid.

title: -12 Locked unused in FigCraft
stmt: The plugin API edits locked nodes as Figma's does.
choice: -12 Locked is not used; FigCraft's locked flag blocks canvas interaction only.

title: No owner-queue cap; wait time charged to caller
stmt: FigCraft events use UserEvent (promoted to Modal), AutomaticEvent and Modal from BUDGETS; a full owner queue never returns -4 because the common per-plugin in-flight bound and backpressure of CON-COM-owner-frame-budget apply.
choice: No FigCraft-specific owner-queue cap; adopt CON-COM-owner-frame-budget.
rationale: A flooder slows only itself and owner-queue memory stays at 64 entries per plugin.

title: Node refs are strings space:n
stmt: Node refs in the plugin API are strings "<space>:<n>" like Figma's "1:23".
choice: Strings, because FigCraft's NodeId(u64) keeps the client space in the high 32 bits so plain JSON numbers could pass 2^53.

title: Server owns plugin data
stmt: The server checks each plugin-data write against the writer's origin, stamps it, enforces quotas and elects an eligible runner per CON-COM-collab-live-write@1.
rationale: Integrity and attribution in live sessions.

title: Canonical, adapter and bridge layers share one gate
stmt: FigCraft exposes three layers (canonical ops, app.figcraft.* adapter ops, and the app.run/app.batch/app.commands bridge) that all pass ext_runtime::gate::admit: step references, resolve, schema, exposure, derive including gate::live_write, permission against declared ∩ granted ∩ context, scope, budget, and execution chosen by Meta and DocumentHost::size.
choice: The adapter never decides a permission and never chooses a thread; the gate does both for all three layers.
rationale: A single enforcement point keeps behaviour identical across layers and in headless runs.

title: 8bf hosting in craft-pshost
stmt: 8bf hosting is built now, superseding v1 decision 25 (8bf hosting excluded).
choice: craft-pshost hosts 8bf, 8BAM included, on macOS and Windows; public shipping follows D-K.
rationale: Largest legacy catalogue, Windows-first. Owner rule: full capability, enforced permissions, third-party notice.

title: Coverage gaps fail loudly
stmt: The target is the full Photoshop event, class and DOM list gated by cargo xtask psdesc --coverage; every entry is mapped and the only lacks items are network features citing DEC-COM-no-plugin-network; a script that reaches one fails with -9 naming the feature, never runs partially.

title: GPU replay adapters
stmt: Bit-exact on one adapter.

title: Vendor handoff
stmt: Per-plug-in native.full vendor-app handoff.

title: UXP layout fidelity
stmt: UXP quirks in Chromium.

title: Adapter file list size
stmt: Adapter file list size
choice: One adapter file list with 5.1 of the PhotoCraft doc, about 1,500 lines; native and compat line names the record tables, TWAIN, the handoff, .jsxbin/E4X, Generator and full-terminology coverage.
rationale: Cross-document alignment recorded in the PhotoCraft cross-doc change table.

title: Brush engines may emit gpu
stmt: Brush engines may emit gpu.
choice: emits = gpu runs stroke simulation in Slot::Paint with sparse paged state.
rationale: Live oils and wet media at pen rate.

title: Common DocumentHost transactions
stmt: The adapter uses common DocumentHost.
choice: ext-runtime txn, scope, writeset, tiles and account; lint no_engine_txn_outside_runtime replaces plugin_host txn, ORIGIN and fixed thresholds.

title: Compat process and file mapping
stmt: Compat layers map File.execute, app.system, openExternal and fs.
choice: They map to process.run, os.open, os.openUrl, file.* with files.paths and plugins.run under derived grants.

title: Cost-routed heavy calls
stmt: Heavy calls route to jobs by cost.
choice: Meta.cost times document size routes heavy calls to jobs.
rationale: Instant commands take seconds at 100 MP.

title: pshost internal
stmt: No SDK surface for craft-pshost.

title: devices.usb with WebUSB semantics
stmt: devices.usb has WebUSB semantics.
choice: devices.usb offers WebUSB semantics plus PTP and OS scan sessions.
rationale: Tethering, scanners and vendor tools in Wasm or JS.

title: Dispatch commands under app.scripts
stmt: actions.play, edit.repeat and command.batch are allowed.
choice: Allowed under app.scripts with every nested step gated by the plugin's origin and mask.
rationale: Origin carry makes nested steps safe.

title: Durable output defaults to full resolution
stmt: Smart filters default to full-resolution durable output; a document preference lowers it.

title: Window and dialog commands visible
stmt: UiWindow and dialog commands are plugin-visible.
choice: UiWindow commands need app.windows; dialog commands take dialog silent or display.

title: v2 fate: atn-cmds-psdesc
stmt: v2 fate: atn-cmds-psdesc
choice: crates/engine/src/cmd/atn_cmds/{events,descriptors,convert,fields,tables,adjustments,steps_*}.rs (12,112 non-test lines): moved into crates/psdesc; atn_cmds keeps file load/save and calls psdesc
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: automate-provenance
stmt: v2 fate: automate-provenance
choice: automate_cmds.rs, atn_cmds.rs and droplets: every file entry point calls sinks::fs::provenance first
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: cmd-overlay
stmt: v2 fate: cmd-overlay
choice: crates/engine/src/cmd.rs:243-246: find chaining replaced by one dynamic overlay cmd::overlay
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: engine-lib-fields
stmt: v2 fate: engine-lib-fields
choice: crates/engine/src/lib.rs:227-230: plugin_gesture and plugin_serving deleted with no replacement field; engine exposes only DocumentHost::{begin, install, commit, abort} and Busy
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: engine-plugin-filters
stmt: v2 fate: engine-plugin-filters
choice: crates/engine/src/plugin_filters.rs (424): replaced by plugin_host/filters.rs on the filter service
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: engine-plugin-ops
stmt: v2 fate: engine-plugin-ops
choice: crates/engine/src/plugin_ops.rs (1,402): replaced by engine/src/plugin_host/; most ops become bridge calls
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: engine-plugin-sessions
stmt: v2 fate: engine-plugin-sessions
choice: crates/engine/src/plugin_sessions.rs (1,196): deleted; transactions, gesture transactions and modal scopes are ext-runtime::txn over DocumentHost; canvas tool routing moves to plugin_host/tools.rs; plugin commands journal through the ordinary Actions recorder
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: engine-plugin-tests
stmt: v2 fate: engine-plugin-tests
choice: crates/engine/tests/plugin_beta.rs and plugin_examples.rs (333): ported to conformance and PhotoCraft suites
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: jobs-authorization
stmt: v2 fate: jobs-authorization
choice: crates/engine/src/jobs.rs:44-80: RENDER_AUTHORIZATION thread-local and AuthorizationScope deleted; Authorization is a value field of every queued job, UI request and post-commit writer
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: plugins-contract-rs
stmt: v2 fate: plugins-contract-rs
choice: crates/plugins/src/contract.rs (431): deleted; replaced by api.lock.json and canonical.rs map
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: plugins-document-thread
stmt: v2 fate: plugins-document-thread
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: plugins-filter-rs
stmt: v2 fate: plugins-filter-rs
choice: crates/plugins/src/filter.rs (123): deleted; pixel conversion moves to crates/plugins/src/pixels.rs on the data plane
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: plugins-lib
stmt: v2 fate: plugins-lib
choice: crates/plugins/src/lib.rs (271 lines): rewritten as crate root and runtime(); impl CraftApp lives in app.rs
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: plugins-resources-rs
stmt: v2 fate: plugins-resources-rs
choice: crates/plugins/src/resources.rs (164): folded into resources.rs of the new adapter
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: plugins-runtime-rs
stmt: v2 fate: plugins-runtime-rs
choice: crates/plugins/src/runtime.rs (657): deleted; behaviour lives in ext-runtime
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: plugins-session-filters
stmt: v2 fate: plugins-session-filters
choice: crates/plugins/src/session_filters.rs (182): deleted; Meta and exposure replace allowlists
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: print-cmds-sink
stmt: v2 fate: print-cmds-sink
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: session-execute
stmt: v2 fate: session-execute
choice: crates/engine/src/session/execute.rs:19-33: plugin.session.* and plugin.uiEvent special cases removed; one dispatch path
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: ui-panels-registry
stmt: v2 fate: ui-panels-registry
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: ui-plugin-form
stmt: v2 fate: ui-plugin-form
choice: crates/ui-egui/src/plugin_form.rs (182): replaced by ext-ui-fw form renderer
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: v2 fate: ui-plugins-ui
stmt: v2 fate: ui-plugins-ui
choice: crates/ui-egui/src/plugins_ui.rs (527): replaced by ui-egui/src/plugin_shell/ implementing HostUi
rationale: Behaviour lives in one place; replaces in-process plugin host

title: GPU GT3 programs built
stmt: GT3 recorded GPU programs are built.

title: JavaScript compat built
stmt: JavaScript, descriptors, ExtendScript and Node are built.
choice: V8 on desktop, QuickJS on web; UXP, ExtendScript and Generator via psdesc; Node via node-compat.

title: Kept behaviours tested first
stmt: Eight kept behaviours are tests green at M1 and gate task 2's deletions; safe mode is CRAFT_SAFE_MODE.

title: Native-UI helper profile
stmt: craft-sandbox-launch has a native-UI profile.
choice: No lpacCom, clipboard limited unless granted; ui.window:* and app.shortcuts grantable.

title: PhotoCraft never list and pshost profile
stmt: PhotoCraft adds no never-grantable entries; D-B and D-P apply; craft-pshost shares craft-aehost's Windows native-UI profile, lpacCom behind lpac_com_native_ui and C-LPAC.

title: One exposure function for automation and plugins
stmt: Automation and plugin command exposure share one function.
choice: Replace authorize_engine_command and plugin allowlists with craft-command exposure(meta, principal); automation decision stays equal to today's for every command (C6).
rationale: Single source of exposure truth prevents divergent allowlists.

title: Generator inside photoshop-compat
stmt: photoshop-generator@1 lives in photoshop-compat.

title: Print, fonts and reveal permitted
stmt: Print, fonts and reveal are permissions.
choice: print, fonts.activate, fonts.system and os.reveal replace the old refusal.

title: Provenance of plugin-written scripts
stmt: Plugin-written scripts and Actions keep their origin.
choice: They run as Origin::Plugin(writer) or after the written-by sheet; Trust File clears.
rationale: A folder grant is not user authority.

title: Smart-filter output shares tiles
stmt: Durable smart-filter output shares the rendered tile tree.
rationale: 800 MB writes per drag at 100 MP.

title: Undo::Manages under history.control
stmt: Undo::Manages is plugin-visible.
choice: Undo, redo, states and purge under history.control:navigate; snapshots under history.control:snapshot; outside a transaction a host step of its own; inside a script run or txn.modal, states created in the run are savepoints.
rationale: History panels and export scripts use it.

title: UXP pages in CEF
stmt: UXP pages run the photoshop-compat page runtime in a T6 CEF page.
choice: Follows the D-D web switch (DEC-COM-d-d): at CefWindow UXP panels float as slot-following palettes; at CefDocked or CefDockedCompat docked panels follow their slot and only undocked windows count.
rationale: Retouching Toolkit, Infinite Color and TK8 run unmodified.

title: Web build plugins in a Web Worker
stmt: Plugins run in the web build.

title: Workstream updates for PhotoCraft
stmt: PC-18 holds the coverage gate, savepoints and Generator; WS12 holds record tables, handoff and TWAIN; corpus 71 items.

title: CEF only for web windows
stmt: Web windows use CEF only.
choice: Replace the system webview with CEF.
rationale: System webviews run their network outside the helper's sandbox (WebView2 is not OS-confined)

title: Devices broker USB
stmt: USB, PTP and scan in the devices broker.

title: GPU driver residual
stmt: Driver bugs can reset the GPU; gpu.compile and gpu.direct disclose it.

title: Setup-time consent
stmt: Approve once at setup with hardware input.

title: macOS launch path
stmt: S-W1 compares XPC service and posix_spawn helper launch under App Sandbox; XPC sets ProcessType Interactive.
choice: The path meeting every IPC1 row per PowerState, USER_INTERACTIVE ring wakes and <=5 ms spawn; posix_spawn if both pass.
rationale: XPC services are Adaptive and ring wakes carry no QoS boost.

title: D-P native UI COM and pasteboard
stmt: Native UI helpers get lpacCom and, with a grant, the pasteboard.

title: Minimal never list
stmt: N1-N7 only; all else grantable.

title: os.open allow-list
stmt: Plugin-written files open directly only from an allow-list.

title: Shell commands
stmt: Shell lines at L4 full confinement.

title: 8BAM handles
stmt: 8BAM gets only the picked device.

title: pshost notices
stmt: pshost carries native_ui and native_host notices.

title: Accepted residuals
stmt: Full access, capture and input seeing other apps, sync and clipboard exfil, daemons and companions online, opened files, steganography, fonts parsers, unmarked native writes, USB firmware.

title: Scope -3
stmt: Scope violations return -3 like absent ids.

title: Shared threads
stmt: threads=shared at every tier.

title: S-WEB1 failure never restores
stmt: Failure of S-WEB1 on a platform blocks ext-web there and does not bring back a system webview.

title: Shared engine, separate renderers
stmt: Plugins share the browser and GPU processes; isolation between plugins is the renderer boundary.
rationale: Same model as browsers between sites; disclosed in section 16.

title: pshost LPAC
stmt: Per-vendor-folder LPAC.
